attempts.summary: Deployed a WireGuard gateway topology: node2 serves an HTTP app on TCP 8080 bound only to its private interface (10.50.50.11), reachable exclusively via a WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1 (VyOS, wg0 10.200.0.1/24, listening on eth0's public-shared address). node3 connects as a WG client (10.200.0.2) and reaches the app at 10.50.50.11:8080 only through the tunnel; direct access from node3 to node2 over the shared 10.100.3.0/24 network is blocked (app not listening there). NAT masquerade on node1's eth1 lets node2 route return traffic back through node1 without extra routes on node2. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery (config persistence, service auto-start, tunnel re-handshake, app reachability, and continued blocking of the direct path).
